title: Noxious Fumes
description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
smart_description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
notes: This is a Counter-type power. Each stack increases the amount of Poison applied to all enemies at turn start. The power applies Poison via its counter value (Amount). Also displays a hover tip linking to Poison for reference.
